goal: Correct the theme transition so the new color visibly expands from the mode icon.
changes: Use View Transitions API with a circular clip-path when available.
Keep the old theme visible until the clip-path fallback reaches the viewport, then persist the new mode.
Sample the target page background before switching and apply it to the fallback layer.
Tune both paths to 0.84 seconds with a smooth cubic-bezier easing and preserve the trigger button center as the reveal origin.

commands.result: passed; vue-tsc and Vite production build completed

browser_evidence: In the local browser without View Transitions API support, a screenshot captured during the fallback showed a curved light-theme boundary expanding from the top-right mode icon toward the lower-left page area.
